title: How to Make a Resume That Gets YOU HIRED in 2026
description:
Learn how to make a professional resume that stands out! In this video, I share actionable tips from reviewing thousands of resumes and hiring for startups and global companies. You’ll discover the Create, Curate, Craft framework to organize and tailor your resume, free tools like Teal to optimize it, and best practices to make it ATS-friendly. Whether you’re just starting or refreshing your resume, this guide has everything you need to land your next job. Let’s build a resume that works!
